name: swarm-to-systemd
description: Capture a Docker Swarm cluster (nodes, stacks, services, networks, volumes, secrets, configs) into a normalized inventory, plan its migration to systemd-native hosts, render Podman Quadlet units, and verify the result. Ships a Managed Agents harness so the same skills run unattended on production servers.

inventory_dir.title: Inventory directory
inventory_dir.description: Where swarm captures and rendered units are written. Defaults to ./.swarm-migration inside the project.
